subject: learning/ci-analyzer-coverage
statement: The shared local and GitHub code gate runs pinned golangci-lint with modernize and unparam because go vet alone did not catch the editor findings. Every changed file is checked against a fixed adoption commit. In implement-now, fmt.Appendf replaces formatted byte conversions and the unused unattended journal argument is removed; the CLI flag remains accepted for compatibility while journaling behavior is preserved.
intent: Keep the reported editor findings reproducible in CI and preserve CLI compatibility while removing the unused parameter.
rationale: The reported fmtappendf and unusedparams diagnostics came from analyzers that the previous gate never invoked. A fixed baseline with whole-file lint also catches an unused parameter when only the function body changes.
fit_criterion: Pinned lint rejects fixtures containing both original findings and passes corrected fixtures; implementation race tests preserve journaling behavior and gopls reports no findings in the reported files.
